economy.summary: Voted for House Bill 2189 in March 2026, which would raise Pennsylvania's minimum wage in steps to $15 an hour by 2029; the bill passed the House 104-95.
economy.short: Voted to raise the state minimum wage to $15 by 2029.

taxes.summary: Voted for Senate Bill 160, the general appropriations act funding the state's operating budget for fiscal year 2025-2026; the House concurred 156-47 in November 2025.
taxes.short: Voted for the 2025-2026 state general operating budget.

abortion.summary: Voted for House Bill 1957 in December 2025, which would amend the state constitution to establish a right to abortion; the bill passed the House 102-101.
abortion.short: Voted for a state constitutional right to abortion.

education.summary: Voted for House Bill 1663 in December 2025, which would establish the Pennsylvania Children's Literacy Program; the bill passed the House 116-87.
education.short: Voted to establish a state children's literacy program.

healthcare.summary: Voted for House Bill 618 in March 2025, which would prohibit health insurers from denying coverage based on pre-existing conditions; the bill passed the House 125-77.
healthcare.short: Voted to bar insurers from denying coverage for pre-existing conditions.

energy.summary: Voted for House Bill 1032 in June 2023, which would appropriate state funding for solar power projects at public schools; the bill passed the House 134-69.
energy.short: Voted to fund solar power projects at public schools.

guns.summary: Voted for House Bill 1593 in September 2025, which would expand background check requirements for firearm purchases; the bill passed the House 104-99.
guns.short: Voted to expand background checks for firearm purchases.
